groceries = shop=supermarket|convenience; eating = amenity=restaurant|cafe|fast_food. Share (%) of POIs with a parseable opening_hours tag that are open at the check time on the reference week Mo 2026-10-05..Su 2026-10-11, PH/SH rules ignored: late = Wed 23:00, early = Wed 07:00, sunday = Sun 12:00, 24h = open every minute of the week.

Value is post-stratified by chain status (brand or brand:wikidata tag): chain_share_all * rate_chain + (1 - chain_share_all) * rate_nonchain, correcting for chains being tagged more often. raw/strata values in detail.
Missing when < 50 parsed tags or tag coverage < 5% of the group's POIs. quality=estimated: tagged POIs are a non-random sample; see etl/notes/osm-hours.md.
